changes: Replace upstream bundled FreeType 2.13.2 with verified 2.14.3 release source
Compile and link native sources from this project
Do not enable or build optional PNG decoding; outlines only
Use DEP_Z_INCLUDE if needed by the native build
Preserve upstream FFI API while suppressing function-pointer equality derive warnings; Fonts never compares callbacks

Define FT_CONFIG_OPTION_SYSTEM_ZLIB and select libz-sys static feature; gzip uses bundled zlib 1.3.2 rather than FreeType private zlib 1.3.1. LIBZ_SYS_STATIC=0 is an explicit build-environment override.
